entries.title: Psalms 38:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.>> O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

entries.title: Psalms 38:2
segments: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

entries.title: Psalms 38:3
segments: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:4
segments: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:5
segments: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.

entries.title: Psalms 38:6
segments: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:7
segments: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 38:8
segments: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 38:9
segments: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 38:10
segments: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:11
segments: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 38:12
segments: They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:13
segments: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 38:14
segments: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

entries.title: Psalms 38:15
segments: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

entries.title: Psalms 38:16
segments: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:17
segments: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:18
segments: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:19
segments: But mine enemies are lively, [and] are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

entries.title: Psalms 38:20
segments: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

entries.title: Psalms 38:21
segments: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:22
segments: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
